title: Configuration
intro: Common paths have typed fields. Everything else in the settings store is editable below at raw JSON level.

dpl.label: OB dplcache_release directory
dpl.description: Source of the unmodified game archives.

mod.label: OB mod directory
mod.description: Destination the repack pipeline writes finished packs into.

extract.label: Extract output path
extract.description: Optional secondary extract root used by Character ID table > Extract to Output Folder. Extract to Workspace uses the EXVS2 Workspace root instead.

debug.label: Character ID debug MSC output root
debug.description: Debug Extract All MSC root; the 040msc route folder is appended automatically.

errors.storeNotReady: Settings store is not initialized yet

raw.title: Raw settings
raw.intro: Every key in {{file}}, edited as JSON. Strings must be quoted. Saving writes to disk immediately.
raw.empty: The settings store is empty. Use Add key to create the first entry.
raw.unsaved_one: {{count}} unsaved key. Each key is saved on its own.
raw.unsaved_other: {{count}} unsaved keys. Each key is saved on its own.
